record.title: Romania prohibits non-exempt third-country entry during the pandemic
record.scope: Inward admission prohibition at state border checkpoints; land, rail and international river crossings within this record
record.crossings: Romanian land frontiers; no assertion that every physical checkpoint shut
record.movement: Non-exempt third-country nationals and stateless persons; ordinary tourist entry affected
record.exceptions: Romanian, EU/EEA and Swiss citizens outside the defined foreigner category; family, residence/long-stay documents, professional travel, diplomats, military, humanitarian protection, transit and imperative travel. Later study, seasonal and other specified work exceptions.
record.imposing_authority: Romanian Government and Ministry of Internal Affairs; Border Police
record.enforcement: Binding order; Border Police described implementation in May 2021.
record.consequences: Ordinary third-country visits restricted; no measured causal economic estimate.
record.relationship: Separate national admission regime from Moldova’s reciprocal rule R2-EU-010 and the two checkpoint suspensions R3-EU-006. These overlapping scopes cannot be added as border-wide closure days.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no status inference at 21 October 2026
record.context: Emergency military order developed into the state-of-alert admission regime; permitted categories expanded before repeal.
record.uncertainty: Start is the explicit legal commencement at 22:00 Romania time. The June endpoint is repeal of the admission ban; health rules and individual crossing availability were separate. The complete sequence of intermediate exceptions is not reconstructed.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established. No single nationwide operational duration is established.

claim_checks.Historical note — current findings are i: Military ordinance and May 2021 border-police operational guidance support exclusion of non-exempt foreigners.

All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): Pandemic order and police explanation explicit.
May 2021 police specifies non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals with exceptions; initial statutory foreigner definition not freshly retrieved.
No complete intermediate amendment chain or individual post reopening proved.
